planning: Two-sided Gaussian budget from pilot paired item means: ceil((z_(1-alpha/2)+z_power)^2 * total_variance / observed_gap^2), minimum 16. total_variance = max(0, observed_variance - mean(within_item_variance)/k) + mean(within_item_variance)/k. Zero-gap or zero-variance pilots are nonestimable; budgets above 512 fresh items are infeasible and are not capped. Every other pair is confirmed.
testing: Two-sided paired t-test of sampled per-item mean accuracy, alpha .05, individual comparisons without multiplicity correction. Detection fraction across selected heterogeneous pairs is not a repeated-trial estimate of 80% power. Same fresh answers reused between overlapping pairs.
freshness: Newly generated responses to disjoint, existing public test items; not newly authored questions or contamination-free evaluation.

grading.gsm8k: Primary: extract the last signed decimal number anywhere in the response, remove commas, normalize Decimal, and compare numeric values exactly; inspired by lm-eval-harness flexible extraction. No number is incorrect.
grading.arc: Primary: last explicit answer/option/choice label; otherwise last parenthesized label or terminal label. Exact match to the original choice label. No option-position randomization. This is generated-answer scoring, not option log-likelihood.
grading.strict_secondary: Original marker-only rules in protocol_initial.json; recomputed on the same stored text, without selecting different items or model outputs.

truncation: Outputs reaching token limit remain scored, with finish_reason retained. No reruns or dropping malformed answers.

pilot_revision.reason: The original evaluation confused answer formatting with accuracy and cut off many ARC explanations. I revised the grader after the pilot and before planning or collecting confirmation.
pilot_revision.gsm8k_action: Regrade the original stored GSM8K pilot answers; no model rerun. Prompts and generation limits unchanged.
pilot_revision.arc_action: Collect the same 64 pilot ARC items again with a 1024-token cap. Preserve the original 128-token answers as secondary data.
pilot_revision.selection_policy: Models, item order, pilot size, pairs, seeds, alpha, target power, minimum and fresh pool are unchanged. No confirmation data had been collected at this revision.
